rounds.response: The audit raises two clear compliance risks: deviation from explicit client contract terms requiring use of the documented discount‑approval workflow, and material exposure to incorrect revenue recognition and weakened internal controls (see ASC 606 and SOX/internal control expectations), which can harm dispute positions and financial reporting. Immediately suspend routine undocumented overrides for discounts above the threshold and instead record any urgent exception in a minimal exceptions register (client, deal value, discount, business rationale, attempted approver, timestamp, sales manager sign‑off) and notify your manager plus legal/finance within 48 hours. To preserve deal velocity, implement a delegated‑approver “fast‑track” matrix with named delegates and a short SLA (e.g., 4 hours) and permit an auditable email‑reply approval template as an interim trail while IT prioritizes fixing the approval tool. For historical overrides, apply materiality‑based remediation: require full documentation only for high‑value cases (e.g., top 50 deals or discounts above a mutually agreed $ threshold) to be submitted within 10 business days, log the remainder for sampling and later review. If you agree, I will draft the exception template, fast‑track matrix, and sample criteria and schedule a 48‑hour stakeholder review with your VP, legal, finance, and IT.
